Game Overview

At its heart, Elite Ghost Sniper is a adventure game about become a master of stealth in Elite Ghost Sniper. Locate and eliminate high-priority targets in dynamic environments. Utilize strategic vantage points to maintain your cover and strike with precision. Hone your skills as you navigate cluttered terrains, challenging your observation and accuracy in this immersive first-person shooter experience.
